description: Stock-market (CNMV) listing tuple of the company and its most recent regulatory events. Use it to check whether a company is listed. Empty coverage is not proof of non-listing. May answer 503 when the integrations projection is offline.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_cnmv
